lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots are organized into semi-regular vertical columns of 3 to 5 nodes each, primarily concentrated between the primary and secondary lateral ridges posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal carinae to define a grid-like structure, with high-intensity circular blobs positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features exhibit a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to shadowed ventral edges, running longitudinally across the visible upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A pale, irregularly shaped depigmentation patch or superficial abrasion is visible on the upper flank, situated dorsally to the second and third gill slits.
